chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Recalling the Brunswick date of early 1940
summary: Asked about a list of titles recorded in 1940, he is unsure which labels the Cats and the Fiddle recorded for.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Do you remember much about the record date you did for Brunswick in early 1940? You did played I Got Rhythm & Cocktails for two, I Ain't Got Nobody, After you've gone
Moonglow... I would do anything for you, Liza, Tea for Two, Honey, suckle Rose.
We did all that many? I didn't know we did that many. Some of 'em was for, what do you call that -- What's the one that started with a "D", Decca...
Bluebell or something... They had a subsidiary... What were the name of the Cats? The Riddle.
